A bug-fix update to v1.0.0.

### Fixed

* **The card now closes when you plug the Kindle into a computer.** Before, it stayed on top of the USB drive screen, and was still there after unplugging until you tapped it. Plugging into a wall charger still leaves it open.

### Downloads

* `inksights-1.0.1.zip`: the Kindle app
* `inksights-backup-calibre-1.0.1.zip`: the optional calibre backup plugin (unchanged apart from the version)

### Upgrading from v1.0.0

Copy the new `extensions` and `documents` folders over the old ones. Your reading log in `reading-stats/` is kept.
